name: Death And Birth
overview: Scripture reveals that life and death are sovereignly ordained by God, who forms each person intimately, as seen in His creation and care within the womb (Psalms 139:13; Isaiah 43:1). From the command to be fruitful and multiply (Genesis 1:28) to the recognition that there is a time for every purpose under heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1), the Bible teaches that birth and death are part of God's divine order. While life is precious, Ecclesiastes reminds us that a good name and the day of death hold profound significance (Ecclesiastes 7:1), and that the living are aware of their mortality (Ecclesiastes 9:5), pointing believers to trust in God's redemptive plan throughout the cycle of life and death.
